scenes.headline: How GOAT gives attention a prior it can learn
scenes.sub: One-sided optimal transport, and where an attention sink lives
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Robin! GOAT reads attention as optimal transport, and uses that to give it a prior it can learn. Here's how.

scenes.text: Softmax attention already solves a one-sided entropic transport problem with a flat prior over keys. GOAT learns that prior.
scenes.say: Softmax attention already solves a one-sided transport problem with a flat prior. GOAT learns that prior.

steps.label: each row sums to 1; columns are free
steps.say: Each query's weights must sum to one. That's the only rule, so nothing caps what a single key collects.

steps.label: the sink: leftover mass on the first key
steps.say: A query with nothing to find dumps its leftover mass on one key, usually the first. That's an attention sink.

scenes.title: Attention with a prior
scenes.say: Add a prior, and the solution is this.

parts.note: content scores over a temperature, as usual
parts.say: Content scores over a temperature, as usual.

parts.note: a learned log-prior, added to each key's logit
parts.say: Plus a learned log prior for each key. A flat prior gives back plain softmax.

scenes.title: How the prior rides along for free

steps.say: The prior has two learned parts: a Fourier series in the query-key distance, and a sink bias for each key position.
Both become extra query and key dimensions, concatenated onto the content vectors.
So it's still one ordinary attention call that fits a fused kernel like FlashAttention, with no Sinkhorn iterations.

left.title: Standard attention
items: The sink's margin must come from content
The model learns a generic, high-norm key
left.say: In standard attention, a sink needs a big content score, so the model grows a generic, high-norm key.

right.title: GOAT
items: The sink's margin comes from the bias u(j)
The content key stays free to be the token
right.say: In GOAT, the sink bias pays for it, and the content key stays free to be the token.

scenes.title: C4 perplexity at the training length, 2,048 tokens
scenes.note: 125M parameters; past training length, ALiBi stays flatter
scenes.say: At a hundred and twenty-five million parameters, perplexity was thirty point nine five, against thirty-two point four nine for ALiBi. Past the training length, ALiBi stays flatter.

scenes.text: A sink is the optimal answer to an uninformative query. GOAT doesn't remove it; it moves it into the prior.

recap: Softmax is one-sided transport with a flat prior
GOAT learns the prior as extra lanes
The sink moves from a key into a bias
scenes.say: To recap: softmax is transport with a flat prior, GOAT learns the prior, and the sink moves into it.
